niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice blend depth psychology (like Carl Jung's framework) with emotional healing and conscious awareness.
Jung Platform: Offers dedicated depth psychology courses like Encounters with the Shadow by James Hollis ($127) and Inner Work and Spiritual Practice by Dr. Lionell Corbett. These programs focus heavily on individuation, confronting the unconscious, and treating psychological shadow exploration as a soulful, spiritual path. Jung Platform +2
Sounds True: Known for accessible digital spiritual growth, offering advanced courses bridging psychological shadow work, mindfulness, and subtle energy work with teachers like Eckhart Tolle, Pema Chödrön, and Tara Brach. Sounds True +2
Awake Academy: Features Embracing the Shadow with Charlie Morley, which integrates lucid dreaming, ancestral shadow healing, and Tibetan Buddhist shadow work practices like Tonglen. www.awakeacademy.org
Insight Timer Meditation Courses: Offers bite-sized, accessible audio courses like Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self for Healing and Growth by Sefy Tofan and Into the Light: A Journey Through Shadow Work, focusing on triggers, somatic body awareness, and inner child healing. Insight Timer +1
Udemy: Features self-paced, budget-friendly practical courses like Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self by Melanie Stevens or The Complete Shadow Work Course, which use journaling prompts, meditations, and trigger identification for beginners. Udemy +1
If you share your experience level (beginner vs. advanced) and whether you prefer a structured academic/Jungian approach or a meditative/somatic practice, I can narrow down the best specific choice for you.
